_comment: Committed .claude/settings.json (project scope, every clone). Team delta over the user file: test runners, git write path guarded by hooks, destructive denies so every clone has them, and the agent-hook ADAPTERS (hooks). No ask list: an ask rule prompts in every mode for every contributor, so it would override a contributor's autonomous profile; commands that must be approved are simply left unallowed (they prompt in Manual mode). Do NOT put model/theme here (personal) or MCP servers here (they go in .mcp.json). See docs-fera standards/tools/claude_code_permissions_standard.md and standards/hooks/agent_hooks_standard.md
_hooks_comment: Agent-hook ADAPTERS only (docs-fera standards/hooks/agent_hooks_standard.md): logic lives in scripts/hooks/ cores and ~/.local/bin/heavy_compute_guard.sh and runs for every actor. Scripts are installed to .claude/hooks/ by scripts-fera install_agent_hooks.sh; the commit gate reports loudly (exit 1, non-blocking) when they are missing, the edit gate stays silent. Keys inside "hooks" are event names, so comments must stay outside it.

hooks.command: if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/hooks/pre_push_gate.sh ]; then bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/hooks/pre_push_gate.sh; else echo "pre_push_gate.sh missing: run scripts-fera install_agent_hooks.sh" >&2; exit 1; fi

if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/hooks/pre_commit_gate.sh ]; then bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/hooks/pre_commit_gate.sh; else echo "pre_commit_gate.sh missing: run scripts-fera install_agent_hooks.sh" >&2; exit 1; fi

_env_example._comment: Move under a real "env" key to enable. Values are literal strings; ${PWD} is not expanded.

_hooks_note: ADAPTERS ONLY (standards/hooks/agent_hooks_standard.md). Logic lives in scripts/hooks/ (quality cores) and ~/.local/bin/heavy_compute_guard.sh (safety guard) and runs for every actor; these entries just give Claude the verdict inside its loop. Installed by scripts-fera install_agent_hooks.sh; never hand-edit .claude/hooks/*.
